evd_title: LLM reviews scored comparably to human reviews on all three expert evaluation criteria
finding: LLM reviews scored comparably to human reviews on all three expert evaluation criteria
P: ~5% random sample (~7-8) of 150 Reviewer Arena papers; reviews by human and GPT-4
I: GPT-4 with full P5 context as review writer and as evaluator
C: Human ICLR 2023 reviewer reviews; 1 human evaluator (ICLR 2023 reviewer)
O: 0-5 rubric, human eval: explains score 4.80 human vs 4.76 GPT-4; GPT-4 eval: 4.27 human vs 4.65 own; guides authors 4.66 vs 4.79
T: ICLR/NeurIPS + Nature papers; GPT-4 snapshot not specified; paper 2024
